svg.title: Marine debris inference pipeline
svg.desc: The original images enter Co-DETR (Co-DINO ViT-L/16), RF-DETR Legacy Large, YOLO26x, and TinyFormer-XL-PBM. Test-time augmentation runs where enabled. Weighted boxes fusion combines original and flipped predictions per detector, then fuses same-class predictions across detectors. Original images and fused candidates define 1.2× context crops for DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 (LoRA), DINOv3 ViT-L/16, and SigLIP 2 ViT-L/16 (384 px). Crop evidence and the unchanged fused candidates enter postprocessing. Each policy rescores detections, can add or swap labels by consensus, and runs class-wise Gaussian Soft-NMS. For each class the assigned policy contributes its detections to a merged pool. The top 100 detections per image are written to submission.csv.

path.aria-label: Add or swap labels by consensus
